items.html: And behold, it was explained above that the matter of the concealment and hiding of the light of AA of holy Atzilut caused a deficiency and a diminution in the Nukva of ZA. And behold, in Beriah, where the light of Aba which is there was also hidden, it therefore caused also a greater diminution in ZA (in AA) which is there, for it too was diminished from its measure. And in Yetzirah the stature of the upper Ima of Yetzirah was also diminished. And in Assiyah the stature of Aba of holiness was also diminished, until there is in Assiyah only the AA which is there, in its measure alone.
